items.title: Add proposal storage and Markdown rendering primitives
items.context: Create a narrow core/handler layer for validating proposal payloads, assigning proposal IDs, rendering deterministic Markdown, and storing story-local decision-doc proposals without writing project docs.
items.userSees: `lattice decision_doc_proposal ...` records a proposal and `decision_doc_preview ...` prints the target Markdown without writing a file.

happy.desc: decision_doc_proposal validates a complete proposal, assigns DDP-001, stores story-local proposal metadata, and decision_doc_preview renders deterministic Markdown without writing docs/requirements/decisions.

edge.desc: Invalid slug, missing required fields, missing alternatives pros/cons, or missing verificationRequirements are rejected with clear errors before metadata is written.

adversarial.desc: Preview is read-only: invoking decision_doc_preview does not modify story metadata, process events, or project decision docs.

verificationEvidence.note: decision-doc-promotion smoke passed 8 checks, including proposal creation DDP-001, story-local proposal metadata, deterministic preview Markdown, and no target doc before save.
Smoke invalid payload check rejects bad slug, missing verificationRequirements, invalid alternatives, and custom nested target path before proposal metadata count changes.

Smoke snapshots decision-doc-proposals.json, raw process-events.jsonl, and store.readProcessEvents before preview, then confirms all are unchanged and no docs/requirements/decisions target is written.

items.title: Implement save with scope, freshness, and overwrite guards
items.context: decision_doc_save must require confirm:true, canonical docs/requirements/decisions/*.md target, accepted PLAN scope or scope extension, fresh proposal/source decision digest, and safe create/update semantics.
items.userSees: `lattice decision_doc_save ...` writes the decision doc only when scope and digest checks pass; stale or out-of-scope saves are blocked.

happy.desc: decision_doc_save with confirm:true and mode=create writes exactly docs/requirements/decisions/<slug>.md for an in-scope fresh proposal and marks/link-records the saved proposal metadata.

edge.desc: Existing target requires mode=update, missing target requires mode=create, and overwrite or mode mismatch fails closed without writing the target file.

adversarial.desc: decision_doc_save rejects stale proposal/source decision digests and rejects targets outside PLAN file declarations, scope contract, or accepted scope extension.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke save(create) writes exactly docs/requirements/decisions/promotion-smoke.md for an in-scope fresh proposal, marks proposal status saved, records save metadata, and stores decision_doc_save process event.
Smoke verifies existing target with mode=create reports target already exists, missing target with mode=update reports target does not exist, and neither path writes the missing-update target.
Smoke verifies outside-scope save refuses before target write, stale proposal digest fails closed, and stale source decision digest fails closed.

items.title: Register commands in CLI, policy, and process fact contracts
items.context: Add schemas/help/aliases plus COMMAND_POLICIES and process fact registry/level updates so the commands have hard runtime ownership, allowed phase, artifact, and Authority-boundary semantics.
items.userSees: `lattice help` lists decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, and decision_doc_save with correct policy behavior.

happy.desc: lattice help exposes decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, and decision_doc_save, and each command routes to the registered handler with expected aliases and schemas.

edge.desc: COMMAND_POLICIES phase/ownership/destructiveRisk settings match the execution plan: proposal PLAN/DEV story-scoped metadata, preview read-only all phases, save DEV story-scoped gateEvidence.

adversarial.desc: Process fact registry and verification script assert proposal/save L4 semantics and explicit non-Authority/non-productionDone boundary text.

verificationEvidence.note: CLI help lists decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, and decision_doc_save with user-facing alias descriptions.

Process fact contract verified command policy phase/ownership/destructiveRisk alignment: proposal PLAN/DEV storyScopedMutating metadata-write, preview readOnly all phases none, save DEV storyScopedMutating gateEvidence metadata-write.
Process fact contract verified proposal/save L4 process fact registration, decision-doc-proposals.json artifact registration, and explicit non-Authority/non-productionDone handler contract tokens.

items.title: Add regression tests for happy, edge, and adversarial paths
items.context: Cover proposal/preview/save happy path, stale digest rejection, out-of-scope target rejection, overwrite guard, missing verificationRequirements, read-only preview, and process fact contract checks.
items.userSees: `npm --prefix packages/main run build` and focused regression commands pass for the new workflow.

happy.desc: Focused smoke test creates a temp project, records decision_set, creates proposal, previews Markdown, saves a canonical decision doc, and confirms target content matches preview.

edge.desc: Focused smoke test covers stale source/proposal digest, missing verificationRequirements, mode mismatch, and overwrite guards.

adversarial.desc: Focused smoke test proves out-of-scope or non-canonical paths are blocked and preview has no write side effects.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke creates a temp project, seeds decision.json, creates proposal, previews Markdown, saves canonical doc, and confirms saved Markdown is included in preview output.
Focused smoke covers stale source/proposal digest, missing verificationRequirements, invalid alternatives, mode mismatch, and overwrite guards.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:decision-doc-promotion-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:scope-contract-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:scope-contract-plan-scope-smoke

items.title: Update documentation only for implemented contract differences

items.userSees: The decision-doc promotion document matches the implemented first-version CLI contract.

edge.desc: If no documentation change is needed, evidence explains why the existing B-16eb document already matches the implementation.
